reason: A read-only GitHub browser for discovering and searching community plugins, with repository metadata inspection, static audit reporting, and agent-facing search and audit tools.

summaries.zh: 用于浏览、搜索和筛选 GitHub 上的社区插件，并提供只读仓库预检与交由智能体审查安装的辅助功能。
summaries.en: A read-only browser for discovering, searching, and filtering community plugins on GitHub, with repository prechecks and agent-assisted review workflows.

capabilities: Browse and search community plugins through GitHub repository metadata and README content
Perform read-only static checks of selected repository metadata, package manifests, scripts, and entry files
Provide search and audit tools for agent use
Read local installation manifests and maintain cached listing, audit, and settings data
Generate prompts for agent-mediated plugin installation and update review
